name: High-Density Urgent Care & Triage Suite
brief: Urgent care center requiring waiting room with physical separation from triage desk, central circulation corridor, 5 standard exam rooms (>=11.15 m2), 1 airborne infection isolation room with dedicated restroom, ADA patient restroom, staff breakroom, and clean utility.

name: Rural Ambulatory Surgery & Endoscopy Center
brief: Ambulatory endoscopy center with public reception, wide 2400mm central stretcher corridor, 2 procedure rooms (>= 23.2 m2 each), pre-op / post-op recovery bay (>= 18.0 m2), sterile supply clean utility, soiled decontamination utility, and ADA staff restroom.

name: Pediatric Dental & Orthodontic Clinic
brief: Pediatric dentistry clinic with child-friendly waiting area, reception desk, central corridor, 3 semi-private operatory rooms (>= 11.15 m2 each), 1 quiet consult exam room, ADA compliant family restroom, and clean sterilization room.

name: Outpatient Oncology Infusion Center
brief: Cancer care infusion clinic with patient check-in, nurse station with direct line-of-sight to corridor, 4 private infusion bays (>= 11.15 m2 each), compounding pharmacy cleanroom, hazardous soiled utility with physical separation, and ADA restroom.

name: Community Behavioral Health & Crisis Clinic
brief: Mental health outpatient center featuring secure waiting reception, wide circulation corridor, 4 sound-attenuated consult therapy rooms (>= 11.15 m2), 1 crisis stabilization room, separate staff breakroom, and single-occupant ADA restroom.

name: Hemodialysis Outpatient Facility
brief: Outpatient dialysis clinic requiring patient entrance waiting, central stretcher corridor (>= 2150mm), 4 clinical treatment rooms (>= 12.0 m2), water treatment equipment room, dedicated clean utility, soiled utility, and dual ADA restrooms.

name: Diagnostic Imaging & Ultrasound Suite
brief: Diagnostic imaging suite with patient reception, central access corridor, 1 lead-lined radiographic procedure room (>= 20.0 m2), 2 ultrasound exam rooms (>= 11.15 m2), patient change dressing room, radiologist reading office, and ADA restroom.

name: Sports Medicine & Rehabilitation Clinic
brief: Orthopedic physical therapy clinic with check-in waiting room, central corridor, large open rehabilitation gym (>= 35.0 m2), 3 musculoskeletal exam rooms (>= 11.15 m2), clean hydrotherapy supply utility, and ADA accessible patient restroom.
